module: Backend (`backendName = "appSelector"`) of the interface's app selector, plugged into the generic GridSelector component. It lists the apps known from `ui_apps.getUIAppsData()` as tiles grouped by category (Dashboard, Telemetry, General, Gameplay, Debug, then the others in alphabetical order), handles search, filtering by type, display options (size, auxiliary content, saved in `/settings/appSelectorData.json`) and the details sheet with the "Add to layout" button. Useful to understand how the app editing screen is fed; of little direct use to a modder.
notes: In simple menu (`Engine.UI.isSimpleMenu()`), auxiliary apps, those with mandatory interactivity (`required`) and Debug-type apps are hidden from the selector.
getTiles also discards `photomode == true` apps and, unless the `includeAuxContent` option is set, auxiliary apps.
The "Add to layout" button (and the double-click) triggers the UI hook `appContainer:spawn` then navigates to the route `pause.hudApps.editlayout`.
The data is recomputed on the next access after onModActivated, onModDeactivated or onModManagerReady.

setDisplayDataOption and resetDisplayDataToDefaults use `displayDataInstance` directly, which is only created lazily by getDisplayDataInstance (called via getAppData): called before any data access, they would fail on nil.
toggleFavourite, getManagementDetails, exploreFolder, goToMod, profilerFinish and closedFromUI are empty shells, present to satisfy the GridSelector API.

getAppData.desc: Returns the selector data (apps, filter instance, filter list, display options), (re)initializing them if needed.

getTiles.desc: Builds the app tile groups (filtered, sorted: non-auxiliary first then by name, grouped by category).

path.desc: Navigation path (not used for the content).

getFilters.desc: Returns the available filters ("set" type filter on app types).

toggleFilter.desc: Enables or disables a filter value. If `requestId` is provided, also returns a snapshot to the UI.

updateRangeFilter.desc: Updates a range filter (not used by the current filters, which are all of "set" type).

getDisplayDataOptions.desc: Returns the display options (tile size: list/tiny/small/medium/large/huge; inclusion of auxiliary content).

setDisplayDataOption.desc: Changes a display option and saves it.

resetDisplayDataToDefaults.desc: Resets the display options to their default values.

setSearchText.desc: Sets the search text (compared in lowercase against the translated name, app name and description).

getScreenHeaderTitleAndPath.desc: Builds the screen's title and breadcrumb (Menu, Edit apps, Apps, then "Filtered"/"Search: …" if needed).

getDetails.desc: Builds an app's details sheet: title, preview, description, specifications (interactivity, version, types, folder outside the shipping build) and "Add to layout" button. Returns a fallback title if the app is unknown.

requestDetails.desc: Computes an app's details sheet and sends it to the UI via the `appSelectorDetails` hook.

executeButton.desc: Runs the callback of a details sheet button via the buttons module.

executeDoubleClick.desc: On a tile double-click, runs the app's "Add to layout" button.

getManagementDetails.desc: Optional function of the GridSelector API: always returns `{buttons = {}}`.

toggleFavourite.desc: No effect: apps have no favorites. Returns false.

exploreFolder.desc: No effect: only writes a message to the log.

goToMod.desc: No effect: only writes a message to the log.

emitDisplayDataSnapshot.desc: Rebuilds the complete snapshot (tiles, filters, options, header) and sends it to the UI via `appSelectorDisplayDataSnapshot`.

returns.desc: true if sent, false if the build failed (error logged).

onRouteMount.desc: Hook called by the UI router when the route is mounted: attaches a selector snapshot to `data.appSelector`.

data.desc: Route data to which the snapshot is added.

onModActivated.desc: Hook called when a mod is activated: forces the data to reload on next access.

onModDeactivated.desc: Hook called when a mod is deactivated: forces the data to reload on next access.

onModManagerReady.desc: Hook called when the mod manager is ready: forces the data to reload.

profilerFinish.desc: Empty function, present for the GridSelector API.

closedFromUI.desc: Empty function, present for the GridSelector API.
